newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian stocks to bide time before Tuesday's FOMC.
newsitem.headline: Belgian stocks to bide time before Tuesday's FOMC.

text.p: Belgian shares firmed on Friday, with the Bel-20 index recovering some of Thursday's 2.5 percent loss, and the bourse seen calm before the U.S. Federal Reserve's policy-making FOMC meeting on Tuesday.
"The market has priced in a 25 basis point rate rise. I'm positive for the market if it's only that much, not 50 or 75 basis points," one dealer said.

Players would be reluctant to open new positions on Monday, the last day of the two-week forward market account. Many institutional investors would be unlikely to leap in before the result of the FOMC meeting was known, dealers said.
The Bel-20 index finished 0.57 percent higher at 2,089.7, after having peaked at 2,118.99 on Friday.

Volume was a hefty 5.87 billion francs worth of Belgian shares, boosted by activity related to the mid-afternoon settlement of March Bel-20 index futures and options as well as individual stock options.
Among shares staging partial technical corrections were insurer Royale Belge, up 2.2 percent at 8,430 francs, retailer GIB, 2.0 percent higher at 1,530, and Koramic, 6.2 percent higher at 1,725.
